Sql:
SELECT p1."UnitateId", p1."ContId", c."Simbol" AS "ContSimbol", p1."PartenerId" AS "ContrapartidaId", r."Denumire" AS "ContrapartidaDenumire", d."ID" AS "DocumentId", NULL AS "DocumentTip", d."Numar", p1."Deschisa" AS "Data", CASE
    WHEN p1."Debit" > p1."Credit" THEN 'Creanta'
    ELSE 'Datorie'
END AS "Sens", abs(p1."Debit" - p1."Credit") AS "Rest"
FROM (
    SELECT p."Unitate" AS "UnitateId", p."Cont" AS "ContId", p."Repartitor" AS "PartenerId", min(p."UnitateDeschisa") AS "Deschisa", COALESCE(sum(CASE
        WHEN p."Sens" = 1 THEN p."Valoare"
        ELSE 0.0
    END), 0.0) AS "Debit", COALESCE(sum(CASE
        WHEN p."Sens" = 2 THEN p."Valoare"
        ELSE 0.0
    END), 0.0) AS "Credit"
    FROM "Postare" AS p
    WHERE (p."Contrapondere" <> 4 OR p."Contrapondere" IS NULL) AND p."Spatiu" = 1 AND p."Carte" = 1 AND p."FelUnitate" = 2 AND p."Unitate" IS NOT NULL AND p."Repartitor" IS NOT NULL AND p."UnitateDeschisa" IS NOT NULL AND p."Data" <= @panaLa
    GROUP BY p."Unitate", p."Cont", p."Repartitor"
    HAVING COALESCE(sum(CASE
        WHEN p."Sens" = 1 THEN p."Valoare"
        ELSE 0.0
    END), 0.0) <> COALESCE(sum(CASE
        WHEN p."Sens" = 2 THEN p."Valoare"
        ELSE 0.0
    END), 0.0)
) AS p1
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT p0."Unitate" AS "UnitateId", p0."Cont" AS "ContId", p0."Repartitor" AS "PartenerId", p0."DocumentId"
    FROM "Postare" AS p0
    WHERE (p0."Contrapondere" <> 4 OR p0."Contrapondere" IS NULL) AND p0."Spatiu" = 1 AND p0."Carte" = 1 AND p0."FelUnitate" = 2 AND p0."Unitate" IS NOT NULL AND p0."Repartitor" IS NOT NULL AND p0."UnitateDeschisa" IS NOT NULL AND p0."DocumentId" IS NOT NULL AND p0."Unitate" = cub_partida_id(p0."DocumentId", p0."Cont", p0."Repartitor")
) AS p2 ON COALESCE(p1."UnitateId", '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') = p2."UnitateId" AND p1."ContId" = p2."ContId" AND COALESCE(p1."PartenerId", '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') = p2."PartenerId"
LEFT JOIN "Documente" AS d ON p2."DocumentId" = d."ID"
LEFT JOIN "Conturi" AS c ON p1."ContId" = c."ID"
LEFT JOIN "Repartitori" AS r ON p1."PartenerId" = r."ID"
ORDER BY p1."UnitateId"
